title: Development and Characterization of a Recombinant Bundibugyo Virus Expressing a Fluorescent Reporter Protein.
abstract: Abstract Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), caused by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), is associated with substantial morbidity and mortality, with previous outbreaks reporting case fatality rates of 30%-50%. The ongoing BDBV outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda highlights the urgent need for virus-specific research tools and medical countermeasures. Unlike Ebola virus disease caused by Zaire ebolavirus, no licensed vaccines or specific therapeutics are currently available for BVD. The lack of research tools has limited studies with BDBV. To facilitate antiviral testing and neutralization studies, we developed the first recombinant BDBV expressing the fluorescent reporter protein ZsGreen (rBDBV-ZsG). As a proof of concept, we tested a set of previously characterized antiviral compounds and demonstrated comparable inhibitory profiles between rBDBV-ZsG and the wild-type BDBV parental strain. Furthermore, the utility of rBDBV-ZsG was successfully evaluated in neutralization assays, demonstrating robust sensitivity and specificity using monoclonal antibodies and convalescent serum samples.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) causes substantial morbidity and mortality with case fatality rates of 30%-50%, and the ongoing outbreak highlights the urgent need for virus-specific research tools and medical countermeasures, as no licensed vaccines or specific therapeutics are currently available for BVD.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study developed the first recombinant Bundibugyo virus expressing the fluorescent reporter protein ZsGreen (rBDBV-ZsG) to facilitate antiviral testing and neutralization studies.
analysis.methods: The recombinant virus was tested with previously characterized antiviral compounds to compare inhibitory profiles with the wild-type BDBV parental strain, and its utility was evaluated in neutralization assays using monoclonal antibodies and convalescent serum samples.
analysis.main_results: The recombinant BDBV-ZsG demonstrated comparable inhibitory profiles to the wild-type BDBV parental strain and showed robust sensitivity and specificity in neutralization assays with monoclonal antibodies and convalescent serum samples.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The development of rBDBV-ZsG provides a valuable tool for antiviral testing and neutralization studies, addressing the previous limitation of lacking research tools for BDBV.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The recombinant virus can accelerate the development of medical countermeasures for BVD by enabling efficient screening of antiviral compounds and evaluation of immune responses.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro proof-of-concept testing, but the evidence strength is high due to the direct comparison with wild-type BDBV and successful validation in multiple assays.

analysis.summary_en: This study developed the first recombinant Bundibugyo virus (rBDBV-ZsG) expressing a fluorescent reporter protein to address the lack of research tools for Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), which has high case fatality rates and no licensed treatments. The recombinant virus demonstrated comparable antiviral inhibition to wild-type BDBV and showed robust performance in neutralization assays with antibodies and convalescent serum. This tool will facilitate antiviral testing and accelerate the development of medical countermeasures for BVD.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本迪布焦病毒病 (BVD) 导致较高的发病率,死亡率 的病死率为 30%-50%,而正在进行的 暴发 突显了对病毒特异性研究工具和医疗对策的迫切需要,因为目前没有针对 BVD 的许可 疫苗 或特定疗法。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发了第一个表达荧光报告蛋白 ZsGreen (rBDBV-ZsG) 的重组本迪布焦病毒,以促进 抗病毒药物 测试和中和研究。
elements_zh.methods: 使用先前表征的 抗病毒药物 化合物对重组病毒进行了测试,以将抑制谱与野生型 BDBV 亲本毒株进行比较,并使用单克隆抗体和恢复期血清样品在中和测定中评估其效用。
elements_zh.main_results: 重组 BDBV-ZsG 表现出与野生型 BDBV 亲本毒株相当的抑制特性,并在单克隆抗体和恢复期血清样品的中和测定中显示出强大的灵敏度和特异性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: rBDBV-ZsG的开发为抗病毒药物测试和中和研究提供了宝贵的工具,解决了之前缺乏BDBV研究工具的局限性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该重组病毒可以通过有效筛选 抗病毒药物 化合物和评估 免疫应答 来加速 BVD 医学对策的开发。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外概念验证测试,但由于与野生型 BDBV 的直接比较以及多次测定的成功验证,证据强度很高。

title: Bacterial infection in Ebola virus disease, Marburg virus disease, Crimean–Congo hemorrhagic fever, and Lassa fever
abstract: Abstract Background Concern for bacterial coinfection in patients with high consequence viral infections (HCVIs) has made the empiric antibiotic administration the standard of care. However, the incidence, microbiology, and clinical significance of bacterial coinfection in HCVIs remain unclear. Methods We conducted a systematic review of case reports, cohort studies, and cross-sectional analyses describing bacterial coinfection in Ebola virus disease (EVD), Marburg virus disease (MVD), Crimean–Congo hemorrhagic fever (CCHF), and Lassa fever (LF). Data were extracted on study design, setting, diagnostic methods, pathogens, antibiotic use, and outcomes. Results Thirty publications met inclusion criteria. Bacteremia was most commonly reported among patients with CCHF (n = 46), followed by EVD (n = 16), MVD (n = 16), and LF (n = 2). analysis.summary_en: This systematic review examines bacterial coinfection in high consequence viral infections (HCVIs) including Ebola virus disease (EVD), Marburg virus disease (MVD), Crimean–Congo hemorrhagic fever (CCHF), and Lassa fever (LF). Among 30 publications, bacteremia was most common in CCHF (n=46), followed by EVD (n=16), MVD (n=16), and LF (n=2). elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 对严重后果病毒感染 (HCVI) 患者细菌合并感染的担忧已使经验性抗生素给药成为护理标准,但 HCVI 中细菌合并感染的 发病率、微生物学和临床意义仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们对 病例报告、队列研究 研究以及描述 埃博拉病毒病 (EVD)、马尔堡病毒病 (MVD)、克里米亚-刚果出血热 (CCHF) 和拉沙热 (LF) 细菌共感染的横断面分析进行了系统回顾。
elements_zh.methods: 从符合纳入标准的 30 篇出版物中提取了有关研究设计、设置、诊断方法、病原体、抗生素使用和结果的数据。
elements_zh.main_results: 菌血症在 CCHF 患者中最常见 (n = 46),其次是 EVD (n = 16)、MVD (n = 16) 和 LF (n = 2)。在非洲以外地区接受治疗的 27 名埃博拉病毒病患者中,有 7 名 (26%) 患有细菌合并感染。在 HCVI 中,菌血症在症状出现后的中位时间(范围 0-23)检测到 11 天,并且与败血症的特征相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 尽管是推动经验性抗生素使用的一个主要问题,但 HCVI 中的细菌合并感染仍然缺乏描述,无法确定其 发病率 或临床意义。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 需要对细菌 诊断 的标准化方案和抗菌药物耐药性特征进行前瞻性研究,以指导抗菌策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于依赖于 病例报告 和 队列研究 研究,而细菌 诊断 和抗菌素耐药性表征的标准化方案有限,因此证据强度中等。

Pathogens included enteric flora, healthcare-associated organisms, opportunistic pathogens, and zoonotic bacteria—most notably Brucella spp. Ceftriaxone was the most common empiric antibiotic but is predicted to have activity against a minority of bloodstream isolates. Mortality among coinfected patients with EVD or MVD was similar to those without bacterial coinfection, whereas coinfected CCHF patients had higher mortality than those without coinfection (15.5%; 95% CI 8.0–25.9% vs 5.7%; 95% CI 5.1–6.4%). Conclusions Despite being a major concern driving empiric antibiotic use, bacterial coinfection in HCVIs remains poorly described, precluding determination of its incidence or clinical significance. Prospective studies with standardized protocols for bacterial diagnosis and characterization of antimicrobial resistance are needed to guide antimicrobial strategies.

title: Vaccine gaps in Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak control and their implications for global public health preparedness and response
abstract: Abstract The present study aims to critically examine recurrent Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreaks—particularly Bundibugyo ebolavirus—with a focus on epidemiological trends, and gaps in vaccinology and public health preparedness, in order to inform concerted outbreak response and global health security strategies. Historical trends show a gradual decline in overall case fatality rates from approximately 65% in the 1970s to around 50% in recent outbreaks, reflecting improvements in clinical care, surveillance, and response systems and potential vaccine impact with estimated approximately 15% impact in CFR reduction from the ITS analysis. However, substantial disparities remain between high-income and low-resource settings. The current epidemic exposes a critical gap in biomedical preparedness, as no licensed vaccines or targeted therapeutics exist for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, unlike Zaire ebolavirus. Hence, outbreak control continues to rely heavily on non-pharmaceutical interventions, including case detection, isolation, contact tracing, and community engagement. Ongoing transmission is exacerbated by conflict, population displacement, and weak health infrastructure. Strengthening preparedness will require sustained global investment in vaccine development, improved surveillance at human–animal interfaces and coordinated international research and response frameworks.

analysis.methods: The study employs an interrupted time series analysis to estimate the impact of vaccines on case fatality rates and examines the current epidemic's biomedical preparedness gaps, particularly for Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Strengthening preparedness requires sustained global investment in vaccine development, improved surveillance at human-animal interfaces, and coordinated international research and response frameworks to address ongoing transmission exacerbated by conflict and weak health infrastructure.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate as the study relies on historical trend analysis and highlights critical gaps but does not present new primary data or randomized controlled trials.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在严格检查复发性 埃博拉病毒病 暴发,特别是本迪布焦埃博拉病毒,重点关注流行病学趋势以及​​疫苗学和公共卫生准备方面的差距,为 暴发 应对和全球卫生安全战略提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了 埃博拉病毒病 病死率的历史趋势,并研究了高收入和低资源环境之间的差异,重点关注本迪布焦埃博拉病毒 暴发。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用中断时间序列分析来估计 疫苗 对病死率的影响,并检查当前流行病的生物医学准备差距,特别是本迪布焦埃博拉病毒。
elements_zh.main_results: 历史病死率已从 1970 年代的约 65% 下降至最近的 暴发 的约 50%,预计较 疫苗 的影响减少 15%;然而,目前还没有获得许可的 疫苗 或针对本迪布焦埃博拉病毒的靶向治疗药物。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调,与扎伊尔埃博拉病毒不同,由于本迪布焦埃博拉病毒的生物医学准备工作存在严重差距,暴发 的控制仍然严重依赖非药物干预措施。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 加强准备工作需要全球对疫苗的发展进行持续投资,改进人与动物接触方面的监测,并协调国际研究和响应框架,以解决因冲突和卫生基础设施薄弱而加剧的持续传播问题。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究依赖于历史趋势分析并强调了关键差距,但没有提供新的主要数据或随机对照试验。

title: Limited Durability of Improvements in Infection Prevention and Control Practices Following Reactive Interventions Leaves Healthcare Facilities Vulnerable to Ebola Virus Transmission.
abstract: We assessed the impact and durability of an infection prevention and control (IPC) bundle intervention during the Kivu/Ituri Ebola virus outbreak (2018-2020). IPC scores increased, then declined 6 months postintervention (median 19/36, 30/36, and 28/36, P < .0001). Without sustained IPC, health facilities remain vulnerable to nosocomial transmission in future outbreaks.

title: Comparative Time–Space Evolution of Bundibugyo Ebolavirus Glycoprotein Across the 2007, 2012, and 2026 Outbreaks
abstract: Abstract Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) is one of the recognized human-pathogenic ebolaviruses and has caused three documented outbreaks in Uganda (2007), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (2012), and the Democratic Republic of the Congo/Uganda (2026). Although complete glycoprotein (GP) sequences are available from these outbreaks, comprehensive comparative analyses integrating their temporal, geographical, and functional evolutionary characteristics remain limited. In this study, 54 complete GP amino acid sequences (676 amino acids) representing the three outbreak periods were comparatively analyzed using a unified amino acid coordinate framework. Complete sequence alignment enabled direct comparison of homologous residues across all isolates without coordinate renumbering. Core amino acid substitution sites were identified, classified according to their evolutionary behavior, and mapped onto established GP functional domains. Comparative analysis identified 21 core amino acid substitution sites distributed throughout the GP sequence. These substitutions were classified into five evolutionary patterns: fixation (n = 10), reversion (n = 4), emergence (n = 2), within-outbreak polymorphism (n = 4), and a rare variant (n = 1). Most substitutions were concentrated within the mucin-like domain (MLD) and the GP1 C-terminal region, whereas the furin cleavage site, internal fusion loop, immunosuppressive motif, and transmembrane domain remained completely conserved throughout all three outbreak periods. Temporal comparison demonstrated that GP evolution occurred primarily through amino acid substitutions rather than insertions or deletions, indicating substantial structural conservation despite continued viral evolution. These findings provide an integrated time–space overview of BDBV GP evolution across the three documented outbreaks and establish a standardized comparative framework for monitoring future genetic variation. The analytical approach presented here may facilitate genomic surveillance and support future comparative investigations of ebolavirus evolution, antigenic diversity, and potential therapeutic targets.

title_zh: 2007 年、2012 年和 2026 年本迪布焦埃博拉病毒糖蛋白的时空比较 进化 暴发
source_body_en: Abstract Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) is one of the recognized human-pathogenic ebolaviruses and has caused three documented outbreaks in Uganda (2007), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (2012), and the Democratic Republic of the Congo/Uganda (2026). Although complete glycoprotein (GP) sequences are available from these outbreaks, comprehensive comparative analyses integrating their temporal, geographical, and functional evolutionary characteristics remain limited. In this study, 54 complete GP amino acid sequences (676 amino acids) representing the three outbreak periods were comparatively analyzed using a unified amino acid coordinate framework. Complete sequence alignment enabled direct comparison of homologous residues across all isolates without coordinate renumbering. Core amino acid substitution sites were identified, classified according to their evolutionary behavior, and mapped onto established GP functional domains. Comparative analysis identified 21 core amino acid substitution sites distributed throughout the GP sequence. These substitutions were classified into five evolutionary patterns: fixation (n = 10), reversion (n = 4), emergence (n = 2), within-outbreak polymorphism (n = 4), and a rare variant (n = 1). Most substitutions were concentrated within the mucin-like domain (MLD) and the GP1 C-terminal region, whereas the furin cleavage site, internal fusion loop, immunosuppressive motif, and transmembrane domain remained completely conserved throughout all three outbreak periods. Temporal comparison demonstrated that GP evolution occurred primarily through amino acid substitutions rather than insertions or deletions, indicating substantial structural conservation despite continued viral evolution. These findings provide an integrated time–space overview of BDBV GP evolution across the three documented outbreaks and establish a standardized comparative framework for monitoring future genetic variation. The analytical approach presented here may facilitate genomic surveillance and support future comparative investigations of ebolavirus evolution, antigenic diversity, and potential therapeutic targets.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本迪布焦埃博拉病毒(BDBV)是公认的人类致病性埃博拉病毒之一,已在乌干达(2007年)、刚果民主共和国(2012年)和刚果民主共和国/乌干达(2026年)引起三起暴发病例。尽管可以从这些 暴发 中获得完整的糖蛋白 (GP) 序列,但整合其时间、地理和功能进化特征的综合比较分析仍然有限。本研究利用统一的氨基酸坐标框架对代表三个暴发时期的54条完整GP氨基酸序列(676个氨基酸)进行了比较分析。完整的序列比对可以直接比较所有分离株的同源残基,无需重新编号坐标。核心氨基酸取代位点被确定,根据其进化行为进行分类,并映射到已建立的 GP 功能域上。比较分析确定了分布在整个 GP 序列中的 21 个核心氨基酸取代位点。这些替换被分为五种进化模式:固定(n = 10)、回复(n = 4)、出现(n = 2)、暴发 内多态性(n = 4)和罕见变异(n = 1)。大多数取代集中在粘蛋白样结构域 (MLD) 和 GP1 C 末端区域内,而弗林蛋白酶切割位点、内部融合环、免疫抑制基序和跨膜结构域在所有三个 暴发 时期保持完全保守。时间比较表明,GP 进化 主要通过氨基酸取代而不是插入或删除发生,表明尽管病毒 进化 持续存在,但仍存在大量结构保守。这些发现提供了 BDBV GP 进化 跨三个记录的 暴发 的综合时空概述,并建立了监测未来遗传变异的标准化比较框架。这里提出的分析方法可能有助于 基因组监测 并支持未来对埃博拉病毒 进化、抗原多样性和潜在治疗靶点的比较研究。

title: Ebola virus exploits host lncRNA LINC01740 to enhance ATF3 and suppress antiviral immune responses 2259953
abstract: Abstract Introduction Ebola virus (EBOV) causes a highly lethal hemorrhagic fever marked by uncontrolled cytokine release and impaired antiviral defense. EBOV primarily infects human macrophages, where uncontrolled replication reprograms host transcription and fuels hyperinflammation. Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs), potent regulators of transcription and immunity, remain largely unexplored in EBOV pathogenesis. We identified EBOV-induced lncRNAs co-regulated with transcription factors (TFs) in primary human macrophages, revealing a novel mechanism by which EBOV rewires host gene expression to promote immune suppression and persistence Methods Using the highly virulent EBOV (Mayinga variant), we infected primary human macrophages from nine donors. We compared protein-coding and lncRNA transcriptomes of EBOV-infected vs. MOCK-infected macrophages at 24- and 48-hours post-infection. Differentially expressed lncRNAs were correlated with adjacent protein-coding genes to infer cis-regulatory relationships. Functional validation used antisense oligonucleotides, CRISPR interference (CRISPRi), and inducible CRISPR—Cas13d knockdown, followed by qPCR, RNA-seq, and Western blotting Results EBOV infection triggered extensive remodeling of macrophage transcriptome. LINC01740 was strongly induced and tightly co-expressed with its neighboring gene, ATF3, a stress-responsive transcription factor known to repress antiviral signaling. LINC01740 knockdown reduced ATF3 expression in macrophages. ATF3 inhibition restored interferon-beta production, enhanced innate immune activation, and induced strong antiviral responses in EBOV-infected macrophages. Our data show that ATF3 impairs IFN-I responses in macrophages, contributing to immune paralysis Conclusion Our data revealed LINC01740 as a novel host lncRNA co-opted by EBOV to enhance ATF3 and suppress antiviral responses. Here we show a novel LINC01740—ATF3—IFN-I regulatory axis driving immune evasion and viral persistence, highlighting lncRNAs as potential antiviral therapeutic targets Funding Source n/a Topic Categories Viral Immunology (VIR)

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how Ebola virus (EBOV) exploits the host long non-coding RNA LINC01740 to enhance ATF3 expression and suppress antiviral immune responses. The researchers infected primary human macrophages with EBOV and identified LINC01740 as a key lncRNA induced by infection, which co-expressed with ATF3, a transcription factor that represses antiviral signaling. Knockdown of LINC01740 reduced ATF3 expression and restored interferon-beta production, enhancing immune activation. The findings reveal a novel regulatory axis (LINC01740—ATF3—IFN-I) that EBOV co-opts to evade host defenses, suggesting lncRNAs as potential therapeutic targets for Ebola virus disease.

source_body_en: Abstract Introduction Ebola virus (EBOV) causes a highly lethal hemorrhagic fever marked by uncontrolled cytokine release and impaired antiviral defense. EBOV primarily infects human macrophages, where uncontrolled replication reprograms host transcription and fuels hyperinflammation. Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs), potent regulators of transcription and immunity, remain largely unexplored in EBOV pathogenesis. We identified EBOV-induced lncRNAs co-regulated with transcription factors (TFs) in primary human macrophages, revealing a novel mechanism by which EBOV rewires host gene expression to promote immune suppression and persistence Methods Using the highly virulent EBOV (Mayinga variant), we infected primary human macrophages from nine donors. We compared protein-coding and lncRNA transcriptomes of EBOV-infected vs. MOCK-infected macrophages at 24- and 48-hours post-infection. Differentially expressed lncRNAs were correlated with adjacent protein-coding genes to infer cis-regulatory relationships. Functional validation used antisense oligonucleotides, CRISPR interference (CRISPRi), and inducible CRISPR—Cas13d knockdown, followed by qPCR, RNA-seq, and Western blotting Results EBOV infection triggered extensive remodeling of macrophage transcriptome. LINC01740 was strongly induced and tightly co-expressed with its neighboring gene, ATF3, a stress-responsive transcription factor known to repress antiviral signaling. LINC01740 knockdown reduced ATF3 expression in macrophages. ATF3 inhibition restored interferon-beta production, enhanced innate immune activation, and induced strong antiviral responses in EBOV-infected macrophages. Our data show that ATF3 impairs IFN-I responses in macrophages, contributing to immune paralysis Conclusion Our data revealed LINC01740 as a novel host lncRNA co-opted by EBOV to enhance ATF3 and suppress antiviral responses. Here we show a novel LINC01740—ATF3—IFN-I regulatory axis driving immune evasion and viral persistence, highlighting lncRNAs as potential antiviral therapeutic targets Funding Source n/a Topic Categories Viral Immunology (VIR)
abstract_zh: 摘要 简介 埃博拉病毒 (EBOV) 会导致高度致命的出血热,其特征是细胞因子释放失控和 抗病毒药物 防御受损。埃博拉病毒主要感染人类巨噬细胞,其中不受控制的复制会重新编程 宿主 转录并加剧过度炎症。长链非编码 RNA (lncRNA) 是转录和免疫的有效调节因子,在 EBOV 发病机制 中仍未得到充分探索。我们在原代人巨噬细胞中鉴定了 EBOV 诱导的 lncRNA 与转录因子 (TF) 共同调节,揭示了 EBOV 重新连接 宿主 基因表达以促进免疫抑制和持久性的新机制。方法使用高毒力 EBOV(Mayinga 变体),感染了来自 9 个供体的原代人巨噬细胞。我们比较了感染 24 小时和 48 小时后 EBOV 感染与 MOCK 感染巨噬细胞的蛋白质编码和 lncRNA 转录组。差异表达的lncRNA与邻近的蛋白质编码基因相关,以推断顺式调控关系。使用反义寡核苷酸、CRISPR 干扰 (CRISPRi) 和诱导型 CRISPR-Cas13d 敲低进行功能验证,然后进行 qPCR、RNA-seq 和蛋白质印迹结果 EBOV 感染引发巨噬细胞转录组的广泛重塑。LINC01740 被强烈诱导并与其邻近基因 ATF3 紧密共表达,ATF3 是一种已知可抑制 抗病毒药物 信号传导的应激反应转录因子。LINC01740 敲除降低了巨噬细胞中 ATF3 的表达。ATF3 抑制恢复了干扰素 β 的产生,增强了先天免疫激活,并在 EBOV 感染的巨噬细胞中诱导了强烈的 抗病毒药物 反应。我们的数据显示 ATF3 损害巨噬细胞中的 IFN-I 反应,导致免疫麻痹 结论我们的数据显示 LINC01740 是一种新型 宿主 lncRNA,与 EBOV 共同选择增强 ATF3 并抑制 抗病毒药物 反应。在这里,我们展示了一种新型 LINC01740—ATF3—IFN-I 调节轴,可驱动免疫逃避和病毒持久性,强调 lncRNA 作为潜在的 抗病毒药物 治疗靶点 资金来源 不适用 主题类别 病毒免疫学 (VIR)

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 埃博拉病毒 (EBOV) 会导致高度致命的出血热,其特征是细胞因子释放失控和 抗病毒药物 防御受损,而 EBOV 发病机制 中的长非编码 RNA (lncRNA) 仍未被探索。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 研究人员使用高毒力的 EBOV(Mayinga 变种)感染了来自 9 名捐赠者的原代人类巨噬细胞,并在感染后 24 小时和 48 小时比较了 EBOV 感染与 MOCK 感染的巨噬细胞的转录组。
analysis_zh.methods: 将差异表达的 lncRNA 与相邻的蛋白质编码基因相关联,以推断顺式调控关系,并使用反义寡核苷酸、CRISPR 干扰 (CRISPRi) 和诱导型 CRISPR-Cas13d 敲低进行功能验证,然后进行 qPCR、RNA-seq 和 Western blotting。
analysis_zh.main_results: 埃博拉病毒感染引发巨噬细胞转录组的广泛重塑;LINC01740 被强烈诱导并与 ATF3 紧密共表达,LINC01740 敲除降低了 ATF3 表达,而 ATF3 抑制则恢复了干扰素 β 的产生并增强了 抗病毒药物 反应。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究揭示了一种新的 LINC01740-ATF3-IFN-I 调节轴,可驱动免疫逃避和病毒持续存在,强调 lncRNA 作为潜在的 抗病毒药物 治疗靶点。

title: Ring and community vaccination for Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak response: a stochastic network modelling study
abstract: Background: Vaccination with rVSV-ZEBOV is highly effective against Zaire ebolavirus, but protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) is unproven. We evaluated the relative population impact and dose efficiency of a partially cross-protective hypothetical vaccine under operationally realistic constraints during a BDBV outbreak. Methods: We developed a stochastic transmission model on a two-layer household-community contact network calibrated to 2026 Democratic Republic of the Congo BDBV outbreak data. Time-varying effective reproduction numbers were estimated using a Bayesian renewal model. We evaluated case detection, isolation, contact tracing, reactive ring vaccination, and community vaccination (20-80% coverage). Base-case vaccine efficacy was 45% and included post-exposure protection against disease and mortality. Primary outcomes were mortality and incidence reductions, total doses, and dose efficiency (doses per death averted) over 90 days, evaluated in a probabilistic sensitivity analysis with 10,000 matched stochastic replicates per strategy. Results: Compared with base operations alone (30% detection, 30% tracing), enhanced operations alone (70% detection, 80% tracing) reduced expected mortality by 81.9% (95% UI 72.3-88.8). Reactive Ring 2 vaccination under base operations reduced mortality by 7.8% (4.7-10.9), requiring 89.5 doses per death averted. Added to enhanced operations, Ring 2 vaccination reduced mortality by 82.5% overall (73.0-88.9), an incremental benefit of 2.7% (0.9-4.9) beyond enhanced operations alone. Community vaccination at 20%, 40%, 60%, and 80% coverage reduced mortality by 44.4% (33.9-51.8), 67.9% (56.7-75.6), 80.4% (70.8-85.9), and 87.2% (79.6-91.3), requiring 40.3 to 80.9 doses per death averted. Interpretation: Strengthened case finding, contact tracing, and isolation averted most deaths even without vaccination. Once these operations were strong, reactive ring vaccination added little further benefit, whereas rapid community vaccination produced the largest reductions in simulated scenarios but required substantially more doses. A partially protective BDBV vaccine's population-level value will depend principally on rapid, broad delivery.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated ring and community vaccination strategies for Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) outbreaks using a stochastic transmission model calibrated to 2026 DRC data. The hypothetical vaccine had 45% efficacy. Enhanced case detection and tracing reduced mortality by 81.9%, while reactive ring vaccination added only 2.7% incremental benefit when combined with enhanced operations. Community vaccination at 20-80% coverage reduced mortality by 44.4-87.2% but required 40.3-80.9 doses per death averted. The findings indicate that strengthened core outbreak control measures are most effective, and a BDBV vaccine's value depends on rapid, broad delivery.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 疫苗接种 与 rVSV-ZEBOV 对扎伊尔埃博拉病毒非常有效,但对本迪布焦埃博拉病毒 (BDBV) 的保护作用尚未得到证实。该研究评估了 BDBV 暴发 期间部分交叉保护假设 疫苗 的相对人群影响和剂量效率。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们在两层家庭-社区联系网络上开发了随机 传播 模型,并根据 2026 年刚果民主共和国 BDBV 暴发 数据进行校准。基本情况 疫苗 功效为 45%,包括针对疾病和 死亡率 的暴露后保护。
elements_zh.methods: 使用贝叶斯更新模型估计随时间变化的有效繁殖数。主要结果是 90 天内 死亡率 和 发病率 的减少、总剂量和剂量效率(避免死亡的剂量),通过概率敏感性分析对每个策略进行 10,000 次匹配的随机重复进行评估。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 即使没有 疫苗接种,加强病例发现、接触者追踪和隔离也避免了大多数死亡。一旦这些操作变得强大,反应性 环形疫苗接种 就几乎没有增加任何进一步的好处,而快速社区 疫苗接种 在模拟场景中产生了最大的减少,但需要更多的剂量。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 部分保护性 BDBV 疫苗 的群体水平价值将主要取决于快速、广泛的交付。研究结果通过强调环形和社区 疫苗接种 方法之间的权衡,为 暴发 响应策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于具有 45% 功效的假设 疫苗 和建模场景,而不是现实世界的实施。由于依赖模拟数据以及有关 疫苗 功效和操作限制的假设,证据强度中等。

Interpretation: Strengthened case finding, contact tracing, and isolation averted most deaths even without vaccination. Once these operations were strong, reactive ring vaccination added little further benefit, whereas rapid community vaccination produced the largest reductions in simulated scenarios but required substantially more doses. A partially protective BDBV vaccine's population-level value will depend principally on rapid, broad delivery.

title: Cost-effectiveness of geographically targeted versus ring vaccination campaigns in response to an outbreak of Ebola Virus Disease caused by Orthoebolavirus zairense
abstract: BackgroundWHO recommends ring vaccination (RV) of Ebola virus disease (EVD) case contact chains to contain outbreaks of Orthoebolavirus zairense. However, this strategy can falter in remote or conflict-affected settings where effective contact tracing is challenging. Targeted geographic vaccination (TGV) - immunising everyone near an EVD cases location without requiring contact tracing - has been implemented as an alternative. We compare the epidemiological impact and cost-effectiveness of TGV versus RV under diverse outbreak scenarios. MethodsWe extended a spatially-explicit individual-based stochastic EVD transmission model calibrated to outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. We simulated outbreaks varying both epidemiological and operational parameters. We evaluated vaccination strategies on total cases, deaths, epidemic duration, vaccine doses used, and incremental net monetary benefit (INMB). ResultsNo single strategy dominates in all scenarios. For better overall response performance, RV results in substantially fewer cases and deaths than TGV (approximately 20% fewer cases), requires fewer doses, and has higher INMB more frequently. Under pessimistic response assumptions, TGV slightly outperforms RV by preventing more infections, curbing the largest outbreaks, and using fewer doses, although the INMBs are similar between strategies. InterpretationDifferent operational contexts recommend different vaccination strategies. Overall, surveillance, contact tracing, and isolation have the most impact on Orthoebolavirus zairense outbreak control. Depending on response effectiveness, the preferred strategy for adding vaccination varies. Backed by effective case detection and management, RV appears the better approach. Under severe response constraints, TGV can be more effective.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed to address the challenge of containing Ebola virus disease outbreaks in settings where contact tracing is difficult, comparing the effectiveness of ring vaccination and targeted geographic vaccination strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: We extended a spatially-explicit individual-based stochastic EVD transmission model calibrated to outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, simulating outbreaks varying both epidemiological and operational parameters.
analysis.methods: We evaluated vaccination strategies on total cases, deaths, epidemic duration, vaccine doses used, and incremental net monetary benefit (INMB) using a spatially-explicit individual-based stochastic EVD transmission model.
analysis.main_results: No single strategy dominates in all scenarios; RV results in substantially fewer cases and deaths than TGV (approximately 20% fewer cases), requires fewer doses, and has higher INMB more frequently, while under pessimistic response assumptions, TGV slightly outperforms RV by preventing more infections and using fewer doses.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Different operational contexts recommend different vaccination strategies; depending on response effectiveness, the preferred strategy for adding vaccination varies, with RV appearing better when backed by effective case detection and management, and TGV being more effective under severe response constraints.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform outbreak response strategies by demonstrating that surveillance, contact tracing, and isolation have the most impact on Orthoebolavirus zairense outbreak control, and that vaccination strategy choice should be tailored to operational context and response effectiveness.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate as the study relies on a model calibrated to specific outbreaks, which may limit generalizability to all outbreak settings, though the model's spatially-explicit design and consideration of diverse scenarios enhance its relevance for decision-making.

analysis.summary_en: This study compares ring vaccination (RV) and targeted geographic vaccination (TGV) for Ebola virus disease outbreaks using a spatially-explicit model calibrated to Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreaks. Results show no single strategy dominates in all scenarios: RV reduces cases and deaths by approximately 20% and has higher incremental net monetary benefit more frequently, while TGV performs better under pessimistic response assumptions by preventing more infections and using fewer doses. The interpretation emphasizes that surveillance, contact tracing, and isolation are most critical for outbreak control, with vaccination strategy choice depending on operational context and response effectiveness. The findings provide tailored guidance for outbreak response in diverse settings.

abstract_zh: 背景世界卫生组织建议 埃博拉病毒病 (EVD) 病例接触链的 环形疫苗接种 (RV) 包含扎伊尔塞正埃博拉病毒 暴发。然而,在偏远地区或受冲突影响的环境中,有效的接触者追踪具有挑战性,这一策略可能会动摇。有针对性的地理 疫苗接种 (TGV)——对埃博拉病毒病病例地点附近的每个人进行免疫接种,无需追踪接触者——已作为替代方案实施。我们比较了不同 暴发 情景下 TGV 与 RV 的流行病学影响和成本效益。方法我们扩展了一个基于空间显式个体的随机 EVD 传播 模型,该模型在刚果民主共和国校准为 暴发。我们模拟了改变流行病学和操作参数的 暴发。我们评估了 疫苗接种 策略的总病例数、死亡人数、流行持续时间、使用的 疫苗 剂量和增量净货币效益 (INMB)。结果没有一种策略能够在所有情况下占主导地位。为了获得更好的总体反应表现,RV 导致的病例和死亡人数比 TGV 少得多(大约减少 20% 的病例),需要的剂量更少,并且 INMB 更高。在悲观反应假设下,TGV 通过预防更多感染、抑制最大 暴发 和使用更少剂量而略微优于 RV,尽管策略之间的 INMB 相似。解读不同的运营环境推荐不同的疫苗接种策略。总体而言,监测、接触者追踪和隔离对扎伊尔塞正博拉病毒 暴发 控制影响最大。根据响应有效性,添加 疫苗接种 的首选策略会有所不同。在有效的病例检测和管理的支持下,RV 似乎是更好的方法。在严重的响应限制下,TGV 可以更加有效。

title: Estimating the effectiveness of syndromic screening at airports for Bundibugyo ebolavirus disease
abstract: We used a stochastic simulation model to estimate the effectiveness of exit and/or entry syndromic screening at airports for Bundibugyo ebolavirus disease (BVD). For a 12-hour international flight from DRC or Uganda at 86% screening sensitivity, approximately 73% of infected people presenting for travel would evade combined exit and entry screening (95% CrI: 68-77%). Among those who successfully boarded, approximately 92% would arrive without detection (95% CrI: 90-94%). This high undetected fraction reflects the relative durations of the incubation period (approximately 7.7 days; Wamala et al. 20101) and the onset-to-severe-disease interval (approximately 4 days; Funk & Abbott 20262): most infected travellers board before symptom onset and are undetectable by any syndromic screen, whilst those who are symptomatic progress rapidly to illness severe enough to preclude travel. Because the proportion of confirmed cases presenting without fever is itself uncertain, we also report a conservative scenario in which all confirmed cases are febrile (0% asymptomatic-equivalent), under which the undetected fraction remains substantial at approximately 64% (95% CrI: 57-70%). This is compounded during active epidemic growth, when recently exposed (and therefore pre-symptomatic) cases are overrepresented among travellers. Syndromic airport screening offers limited protection against BVD spread via air travel, and should be complemented by outbreak control at source, strengthened clinical surveillance in receiving countries with high travel connectivity to affected areas, and post-departure self-monitoring guidance for travellers from affected regions.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to estimate the effectiveness of syndromic screening at airports for Bundibugyo ebolavirus disease (BVD) to address the public health challenge of preventing its spread via international air travel.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research used a stochastic simulation model to evaluate exit and/or entry syndromic screening for BVD on a 12-hour international flight from DRC or Uganda.
analysis.methods: The study employed a stochastic simulation model to estimate screening effectiveness, incorporating parameters such as incubation period (approximately 7.7 days) and onset-to-severe-disease interval (approximately 4 days), and analyzed scenarios with varying proportions of febrile cases.
analysis.main_results: At 86% screening sensitivity, approximately 73% of infected travelers would evade combined exit and entry screening (95% CrI: 68-77%), and among those who boarded, approximately 92% would arrive undetected (95% CrI: 90-94%). Even in a conservative scenario where all confirmed cases are febrile, the undetected fraction remained substantial at approximately 64% (95% CrI: 57-70%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the high undetected fraction as reflecting the relative durations of the incubation period and onset-to-severe-disease interval, noting that most infected travelers board before symptom onset, while symptomatic individuals progress too rapidly to travel. The novelty lies in quantifying the limitations of syndromic screening for BVD under realistic epidemic conditions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that syndromic airport screening offers limited protection against BVD spread via air travel and should be complemented by outbreak control at source, strengthened clinical surveillance in high-connectivity receiving countries, and post-departure self-monitoring guidance for travelers from affected regions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as the study relies on a simulation model with assumptions about incubation periods and symptom presentation, and the proportion of confirmed cases without fever remains uncertain, which could affect the generalizability of the results.

analysis.summary_en: This study used a stochastic simulation model to estimate the effectiveness of syndromic screening at airports for Bundibugyo ebolavirus disease (BVD). The results showed that at 86% screening sensitivity, approximately 73% of infected travelers would evade combined exit and entry screening, and 92% of those who boarded would arrive undetected. Even in a conservative scenario where all confirmed cases are febrile, the undetected fraction remained substantial at 64%. The authors attribute this to the longer incubation period compared to the rapid progression to severe illness, meaning most infected travelers are asymptomatic at boarding. The findings indicate that syndromic screening alone offers limited protection and should be complemented by outbreak control at source, enhanced surveillance in high-connectivity countries, and traveler self-monitoring guidance.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用随机模拟模型来评估从刚果民主共和国或乌干达起飞的 12 小时国际航班上的 BVD 出境和/或入境综合征筛查。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究依赖于对潜伏期和症状表现进行假设的模拟模型,并且不发烧的确诊病例的比例仍然不确定,这可能会影响结果的普遍性。

abstract_zh: 我们使用随机模拟模型来估计机场出入境和/或入境本迪布焦埃博拉病毒病 (BVD) 综合征筛查的有效性。对于从刚果民主共和国或乌干达起飞的 12 小时国际航班,筛查灵敏度为 86%,大约 73% 的感染者会逃避出境和入境联合筛查(95% CrI:68-77%)。在成功登机的人中,大约 92% 的人会在不被发现的情况下抵达(95% CrI:90-94%)。这一较高的未被发现比例反映了潜伏期的相对持续时间(约 7.7 天;Wamala 等人,20101)和发病到严重疾病的间隔时间(约 4 天;Funk & Abbott 20262):大多数受感染的旅客在症状出现前登机,并且任何症状筛查都无法检测到,而那些有症状的旅客则迅速发展为严重到无法旅行的旅客。由于不发烧的确诊病例比例本身是不确定的,我们还报告了一种保守的情况,即所有确诊病例都发热(0%无症状当量),在此情况下,未检测到的比例仍然很高,约为 64%(95% CrI:57-70%)。在流行病活跃增长期间,这种情况变得更加复杂,因为最近暴露的(因此出现症状前的)病例在旅行者中所占比例过高。症状性机场筛查对通过航空旅行传播 BVD 提供的保护有限,应辅之以 暴发 源头控制、在与受影响地区旅行联系密切的接收国加强临床 监测,以及为来自受影响地区的旅行者提供出发后自我监测指导。

analysis_zh.main_results: 在筛查敏感度为 86% 的情况下,大约 73% 的受感染旅客将逃避出境和入境联合筛查(95% CrI:68-77%),而在登机的旅客中,大约 92% 的人抵达时不会被发现(95% CrI:90-94%)。即使在所有确诊病例均发热的保守情况下,未检测到的比例仍然很高,约为 64%(95% CrI:57-70%)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将未发现的高比例解释为反映了潜伏期和发病到严重疾病间隔的相对持续时间,并指出大多数受感染的旅行者在症状出现之前登机,而有症状的个体进展太快而无法旅行。新颖之处在于量化现实流行条件下 BVD 综合征筛查的局限性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,综合症机场筛查对通过航空旅行传播 BVD 的保护有限,应辅之以 暴发 源头控制、在高连通性接收国加强临床 监测 以及对来自受影响地区的旅行者的出发后自我监测指导。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究依赖于对潜伏期和症状表现进行假设的模拟模型,并且不发烧的确诊病例的比例仍然不确定,这可能会影响结果的普遍性。

title: "Blame the bats again": YouTube reactions to the 2026 Ebola public health emergency reveal mistrust, misinformation, and geopolitical anxiety
abstract: Abstract The World Health Organization declared the 2026 outbreak of Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Public engagement on video-sharing platforms such as YouTube offers insight into public perceptions during such crises, particularly in the affected region, yet these reactions remain largely uncharacterised. We analysed public discourse and sentiment surrounding the outbreak, focusing on thematic trends in YouTube comments, using a qualitative synthesis that combined thematic content analysis with topic modelling. Videos were identified through the YouTube Data application programming interface, which returned 50 videos each for the search terms “Ebola” and “Ebola virus disease.” After removing duplicates and excluding videos published before the 17 May 2026 emergency declaration, the 10 most-viewed videos were retained. From 4,457 extracted comments, 4,087 were analysed using Latent Dirichlet Allocation topic modelling, complemented by a lexicon-based sentiment analysis. Five themes emerged: geopolitical and cultural context; public figures, conspiracy theories, and misinformation; disease spread and transmission; public health measures and preparedness; and religious and spiritual interpretation. Discourse was strongly shaped by border concerns, mistrust of institutions, global aid politics, and comparisons with COVID-19, and sentiment was split near-evenly between fear and trust. Effective health communication during this outbreak must therefore address not only the scientific and medical dimensions of the emergency but also its geopolitical, cultural, and religious dimensions, while countering misinformation and building public trust.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to characterize public perceptions and reactions to the 2026 Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, by analyzing YouTube discourse.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This qualitative study analyzed public discourse on YouTube, focusing on the 10 most-viewed videos related to 'Ebola' and 'Ebola virus disease' published after the 17 May 2026 emergency declaration, with 4,087 comments extracted from 4,457 total comments.
analysis.methods: The researchers employed a qualitative synthesis combining thematic content analysis with Latent Dirichlet Allocation topic modelling, complemented by a lexicon-based sentiment analysis of YouTube comments.
analysis.main_results: Five thematic trends emerged: geopolitical and cultural context; public figures, conspiracy theories, and misinformation; disease spread and transmission; public health measures and preparedness; and religious and spiritual interpretation, with sentiment split nearly evenly between fear and trust.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as revealing strong geopolitical and cultural influences on public discourse, including border concerns, mistrust of institutions, global aid politics, and comparisons with COVID-19, highlighting the novel intersection of misinformation and geopolitical anxiety in health crises.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Effective health communication during Ebola outbreaks must address scientific, medical, geopolitical, cultural, and religious dimensions while countering misinformation and building public trust to ensure successful public health responses.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence strength is moderate due to its reliance on qualitative analysis of social media comments, which may not represent broader public opinion and is subject to platform-specific biases, though the systematic approach provides valuable insights into crisis communication dynamics.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed YouTube reactions to the 2026 Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Researchers examined 10 most-viewed videos and 4,087 comments using thematic content analysis and topic modeling, identifying five key themes: geopolitical context, misinformation, disease transmission, public health measures, and religious interpretations. Sentiment analysis revealed near-even split between fear and trust, with discourse shaped by border concerns, institutional mistrust, and COVID-19 comparisons. The findings highlight the need for health communication that addresses scientific, geopolitical, cultural, and religious dimensions while countering misinformation. The study provides moderate-strength evidence on public perceptions during health crises, though social media data may not represent broader public opinion.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在通过分析 YouTube 言论,了解公众对刚果民主共和国和乌干达宣布为国际关注的突发公共卫生事件的 2026 年埃博拉病毒 暴发 的看法和反应。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项定性研究分析了 YouTube 上的公共言论,重点关注 2026 年 5 月 17 日紧急声明后发布的与“埃博拉”和“埃博拉病毒病”相关的 10 个观看次数最多的视频,从 4,457 条评论中提取了 4,087 条评论。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员采用了将主题内容分析与潜在狄利克雷分配主题建模相结合的定性综合,并辅以基于词典的 YouTube 评论情感分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 出现了五个主题趋势:地缘政治和文化背景;公众人物、阴谋论和错误信息;疾病传播和传播;公共卫生措施和准备;以及宗教和精神解释,恐惧和信任之间的情绪几乎平分秋色。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为揭示了地缘政治和文化对公共话语的强烈影响,包括边境问题、对机构的不信任、全球援助政治以及与 COVID-19 的比较,突显了健康危机中错误信息和地缘政治焦虑的新交叉。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 埃博拉 暴发 期间有效的健康沟通必须解决科学、医学、地缘政治、文化和宗教层面的问题,同时反击错误信息并建立公众信任,以确保成功的公共卫生应对措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据强度中等,因为它依赖于社交媒体评论的定性分析,尽管系统方法为危机沟通动态提供了有价值的见解,但社交媒体评论可能无法代表更广泛的公众舆论,并且会受到特定平台的偏见的影响。

title_zh: “再次责怪蝙蝠”:YouTube 对 2026 年埃博拉突发公共卫生事件的反应揭示了不信任、错误信息和地缘政治焦虑
source_body_en: Abstract The World Health Organization declared the 2026 outbreak of Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Public engagement on video-sharing platforms such as YouTube offers insight into public perceptions during such crises, particularly in the affected region, yet these reactions remain largely uncharacterised. We analysed public discourse and sentiment surrounding the outbreak, focusing on thematic trends in YouTube comments, using a qualitative synthesis that combined thematic content analysis with topic modelling. Videos were identified through the YouTube Data application programming interface, which returned 50 videos each for the search terms “Ebola” and “Ebola virus disease.” After removing duplicates and excluding videos published before the 17 May 2026 emergency declaration, the 10 most-viewed videos were retained. From 4,457 extracted comments, 4,087 were analysed using Latent Dirichlet Allocation topic modelling, complemented by a lexicon-based sentiment analysis. Five themes emerged: geopolitical and cultural context; public figures, conspiracy theories, and misinformation; disease spread and transmission; public health measures and preparedness; and religious and spiritual interpretation. Discourse was strongly shaped by border concerns, mistrust of institutions, global aid politics, and comparisons with COVID-19, and sentiment was split near-evenly between fear and trust. Effective health communication during this outbreak must therefore address not only the scientific and medical dimensions of the emergency but also its geopolitical, cultural, and religious dimensions, while countering misinformation and building public trust.

title: What the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda reveals about epidemic preparedness in West Africa
abstract: The 2026 Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has exposed critical vulnerabilities in epidemic preparedness despite substantial investments in health security following previous Ebola epidemics. Unlike outbreaks caused by the Zaire strain of Ebola virus, no licensed vaccines, approved therapeutics, or widely available rapid diagnostics currently exist for Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease. Consequently, affected countries have had to respond to an active outbreak while simultaneously generating evidence to guide control measures. In this perspective, we argue that while substantial global frameworks exist, including CEPI’s 100 Days Mission, WHO’s R&D Blueprint, and Africa CDC’s initiatives, the operationalization of research readiness systems at regional and national levels remains an area requiring continued investment. Drawing on experiences from West Africa following the 2014–2016 Ebola epidemic, we hypothesize that the absence of pre-approved protocols, standing ethics mechanisms, clinical trial networks, and emergency financing arrangements may represent a more critical gap than the absence of medical countermeasures themselves. We wish to clarify that our argument is not that research is absent during outbreaks; indeed, significant research efforts have been mounted during the Bundibugyo outbreak, but rather that the speed with which research can be initiated is constrained by the absence of pre-positioned systems. We reflect on progress in surveillance, laboratory systems, and regional coordination while highlighting persistent weaknesses in regulatory harmonization, emergency financing, cross-border collaboration, and community engagement. We discuss how the Lassa Fever Coalition in West Africa and global initiatives such as CEPI’s 100 Days Mission provide useful frameworks for strengthening preparedness before crises occur. We contend that epidemic preparedness should be viewed not only as a technical exercise but also as a political, institutional, and social investment and that research readiness requires systematic attention as a core component of health security. Sustained commitment to research readiness, financing, and regional collaboration will be essential if West Africa is to respond effectively to future epidemic threats.
journal: Journal of Interventional Epidemiology and Public Health

analysis.summary_en: This perspective article analyzes the 2026 Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda to evaluate epidemic preparedness in West Africa. Despite global frameworks like CEPI's 100 Days Mission and WHO's R&D Blueprint, critical vulnerabilities persist, including the absence of licensed vaccines, therapeutics, and diagnostics for Bundibugyo Ebola. title_zh: 刚果民主共和国和乌干达的本迪布焦埃博拉 暴发 揭示了西非的流行病防范工作
source_body_en: The 2026 Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has exposed critical vulnerabilities in epidemic preparedness despite substantial investments in health security following previous Ebola epidemics. Unlike outbreaks caused by the Zaire strain of Ebola virus, no licensed vaccines, approved therapeutics, or widely available rapid diagnostics currently exist for Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease. Consequently, affected countries have had to respond to an active outbreak while simultaneously generating evidence to guide control measures. In this perspective, we argue that while substantial global frameworks exist, including CEPI’s 100 Days Mission, WHO’s R&D Blueprint, and Africa CDC’s initiatives, the operationalization of research readiness systems at regional and national levels remains an area requiring continued investment. Drawing on experiences from West Africa following the 2014–2016 Ebola epidemic, we hypothesize that the absence of pre-approved protocols, standing ethics mechanisms, clinical trial networks, and emergency financing arrangements may represent a more critical gap than the absence of medical countermeasures themselves. We wish to clarify that our argument is not that research is absent during outbreaks; indeed, significant research efforts have been mounted during the Bundibugyo outbreak, but rather that the speed with which research can be initiated is constrained by the absence of pre-positioned systems. We reflect on progress in surveillance, laboratory systems, and regional coordination while highlighting persistent weaknesses in regulatory harmonization, emergency financing, cross-border collaboration, and community engagement. We discuss how the Lassa Fever Coalition in West Africa and global initiatives such as CEPI’s 100 Days Mission provide useful frameworks for strengthening preparedness before crises occur. We contend that epidemic preparedness should be viewed not only as a technical exercise but also as a political, institutional, and social investment and that research readiness requires systematic attention as a core component of health security. Sustained commitment to research readiness, financing, and regional collaboration will be essential if West Africa is to respond effectively to future epidemic threats.
abstract_zh: 2026年刚果民主共和国(DRC)和乌干达的邦迪布焦埃博拉病毒暴发暴露了疫情准备方面的关键脆弱性,尽管在前几次埃博拉疫情后已对卫生安全进行了大量投资。与由埃博拉病毒埃博拉病毒的扎伊尔株引起的暴发不同,目前尚无针对邦迪布焦埃博拉病毒埃博拉病毒病的许可疫苗、获批的治疗药物或广泛可用的快速诊断方法。因此,受影响国家不得不在同时生成指导控制措施的循证证据的同时应对活跃的暴发。在本观点文章中,我们认为,尽管存在大量全球框架,包括CEPI的100天任务、世卫组织的研发蓝图和非洲疾控中心的倡议,但在区域和国家层面实施研究准备系统仍是需要持续投入的领域。借鉴2014-2016年埃博拉疫情后西非的经验,我们假设,预先批准的方案、常设伦理机制、临床试验网络和紧急融资安排的缺失可能比医疗对策本身的缺失代表更关键的差距。我们希望澄清,我们的论点并非认为在暴发期间研究缺失;事实上,在邦迪布焦埃博拉病毒暴发期间已开展了大量研究工作,而是研究启动的速度因预先部署系统的缺失而受到限制。我们反思了监测、实验室系统和区域协调方面的进展,同时强调了在监管协调、紧急融资、跨境合作和社区参与方面存在的持续弱点。我们讨论了西非的拉沙热联盟和全球性倡议(如CEPI的100天任务)如何为危机前加强准备工作提供了有用的框架。我们认为,疫情准备不仅应被视为技术性工作,还应被视为政治、制度和社会投资,而研究准备需要作为卫生安全的核心组成部分得到系统性关注。如果西非要有效应对未来的疫情威胁,对研究准备、融资和区域合作的持续承诺将是必不可少的。

title: Fever Temperatures Differentially Alter Ebola-Antibody Functionality Depending on Affinity Maturation 2306819
abstract: Abstract Introduction In 2013-16, Western Africa experienced the largest known outbreak of the highly lethal virus, Ebolavirus (EBOV) and ongoing sporadic outbreaks have occurred since. EBOV is the causative agent of EBOV hemorrhagic fever, characterized by a high-grade fever. Antibody responses to EBOV have been correlated with protection against EBOV disease. However, it is unclear how antibody functions result in protection from repeat exposure. Understanding antibody-mediated mechanisms of protection against Ebola infection is critical to maximize long-term protection against infection. Methods We utilize a systems serology approach to analyze a cohort of 60 survivors of the 2013-16 Ebola epidemic in Guinea and 81 individuals of pygmy ancestry in the Republic of Congo who did not have documented EBOV infection, but do experience frequent zoonotic exposures to characterize the impact of fever conditions on affinity matured EBOV-directed antibody responses. Antibody binding and cellular activation were measured at both physiologic (37C) and high grade fever (40C) temperatures. Results We show that neutralization of EBOV is impaired under fever temperatures, both for affinity-matured and non-specific antibody responses. In contrast, effector-mediated functions, particularly against the EBOV soluble glycoprotein (sGP, a signature previously linked to enhanced protection in animal vaccine challenge models), are enhanced at febrile temperatures. This temperature-sensitive enhancement of effector function correlates with full length GP and sGP-directed IgG subclasses, IgA, FcγR-binding- and FcαR-binding antibodies, demonstrating a highly associated network of humoral features that are maintained during periods of febrile temperatures. Conclusion Collectively, our findings suggest that although neutralization plays a key role in surveillance in a non-fever state, fever modulates affinity-matured antibody responses to the hemorrhagic fever-inducing EBOV, moving antibody profiles to a pro-effector function phenotype. Funding Source NIH NIAID U19 AI135995 Topic Categories Viral Immunology (VIR)

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用系统 血清学 方法对 2013-16 年几内亚埃博拉疫情的 60 名幸存者和刚果共和国的 81 名侏儒血统个体进行了 队列研究 分析,这些幸存者没有记录到埃博拉病毒感染情况,但经常接触人畜共患病。
elements_zh.methods: 在生理 (37°C) 和高烧 (40°C) 温度下测量抗体结合和细胞激活,以表征发烧条件对亲和力成熟的 EBOV 导向抗体反应的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究表明,在发烧温度下,亲和力成熟和非特异性抗体反应的埃博拉病毒中和作用都会受到损害,而效应介导的功能,特别是针对埃博拉病毒可溶性糖蛋白的功能,在发烧温度下会增强。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,发烧调节亲和力成熟的抗体对埃博拉病毒的反应,将抗体谱转变为前效应子功能表型,这是理解温度依赖性抗体功能的一个新发现。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为 监测 和 疫苗 的设计提供了信息,表明虽然中和作用在非发烧状态下是关键,但发烧条件增强了效应器功能,可用于改进保护策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于该研究的观察性质和对仅抽象数据的依赖,可能缺乏详细的方法和统计严谨性,因此证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 摘要 介绍 2013-16 年,西非经历了已知最大规模的高致命病毒埃博拉病毒(EBOV)暴发,此后又发生了持续的散发性 暴发。埃博拉病毒是埃博拉病毒出血热的病原体,其特征是高烧。对 EBOV 的抗体反应与预防 EBOV 疾病相关。然而,尚不清楚抗体的功能如何防止重复暴露。了解抗体介导的埃博拉感染保护机制对于最大限度地长期预防感染至关重要。方法 我们利用系统 血清学 方法对 2013-16 几内亚埃博拉疫情的 60 名幸存者和刚果共和国的 81 名侏儒血统个体进行 队列研究 分析,这些幸存者没有记录到埃博拉病毒感染,但确实经历过频繁的人畜共患病暴露,以表征发烧状况对亲和力成熟的埃博拉病毒导向抗体反应的影响。在生理温度 (37°C) 和高烧温度 (40°C) 下测量抗体结合和细胞激活。结果我们发现,对于亲和力成熟的抗体反应和非特异性抗体反应,在发烧温度下,EBOV 的中和作用都会受到损害。相比之下,效应子介导的功能,特别是针对 EBOV 可溶性糖蛋白(sGP,以前与动物 疫苗 攻击模型中增强保护有关的特征),在发热时会增强。这种效应功能的温度敏感性增强与全长 GP 和 sGP 导向的 IgG 亚类、IgA、FcγR 结合抗体和 FcαR 结合抗体相关,证明了在发热期间维持的高度相关的体液特征网络。结论 总的来说,我们的研究结果表明,虽然中和在非发烧状态下的 监测 中发挥关键作用,但发烧调节亲和力成熟的抗体对引起出血热的 EBOV 的反应,将抗体谱转变为前效应子功能表型。资金来源 NIH NIAID U19 AI135995 主题类别 病毒免疫学 (VIR)

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用系统 血清学 方法对 2013-16 年几内亚埃博拉疫情的 60 名幸存者和刚果共和国的 81 名侏儒血统个体进行了 队列研究 分析,这些幸存者没有记录到埃博拉病毒感染情况,但经常接触人畜共患病。

analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于该研究的观察性质和对仅抽象数据的依赖,可能缺乏详细的方法和统计严谨性,因此证据强度中等。

title: Digital Health for Pandemic Preparedness: A Critical Review of Innovations, Equity Gaps, and Governance in Infectious Disease Surveillance
abstract: Context: Recent infectious disease emergencies, including SARS-CoV-2, mpox (2022 - 2024), highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) in US dairy cattle (2024 - 2025), and the Marburg virus in Rwanda (2024), have strained traditional surveillance systems. Digital health has been proposed as a paradigm shift; however, most reviews have focused on diagnostic accuracy while neglecting equity and governance. Evidence Acquisition: We conducted a structured thematic narrative review of peer-reviewed and grey literature published from January 2010 to March 2025, reported in accordance with PRISMA 2020 and PRISMA-ScR. PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science were searched from February 5 to 18, 2025. Search keywords combined three concept blocks: (1) Digital-health technologies (artificial intelligence, machine learning, mHealth, eHealth, telemedicine, electronic health records, wearables, wastewater surveillance, genomic surveillance, natural-language processing); (2) infectious diseases (outbreak, pandemic, epidemic, COVID-19, Ebola, Zika, mpox, influenza, antimicrobial resistance, Marburg); and (3) public-health functions (surveillance, detection, forecasting, contact tracing, governance, equity). Full Boolean syntax is provided. Records were deduplicated in EndNote X20 and screened by 2 blinded reviewers in Rayyan (Cohen κ = 0.81). Empirical studies were appraised using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool 2018, and reviews were appraised using Joanna Briggs Institute checklists. The synthesis followed Braun and Clarke's reflexive thematic analysis and was interpreted through sociotechnical systems and data justice lenses. Results: Of 1498 records, 142 studies met the inclusion criteria; 48% (69/142) were rated as high quality. The evidence base was heavily skewed regionally (high-income countries [HICs], 41%; sub-Saharan Africa or South Asia, 19%). No technology was universally superior. Artificial intelligence (AI) studies were concentrated in HICs (18/32, 56%), whereas short-message-service (SMS) mHealth studies were concentrated in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs; 15/25, 60%). Recurring barriers included algorithmic bias, fragmented interoperability, donor-dependent sustainability, and slow benefit-sharing of pathogen data with LMICs. Conclusions: Across 142 included studies the synthesis supports a measured conclusion: Digital health is necessary but not sufficient for pandemic preparedness. The patterns most consistently observed in the evidence — regional skew, recurring governance failures, donor-dependent sustainability, and design choices that determine equity outcomes — together indicate that equity, sustainability, and accountability are constituents of effectiveness rather than obstacles to it. The binding constraint is increasingly political and institutional will rather than analytic uncertainty.

title: It’s not just virology: The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda demands a wider public health response
abstract: The current outbreak of Ebola disease caused by the Bundibugyo virus (species Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda is much more than another infectious disease emergency. It reminds us that epidemics come not only from biological pathogens but also from social inequities, environmental disruption, fragile health systems, and persistent armed conflict. While Ebola captures headlines because of its fear-provoking symptoms and high mortality, the conditions that allow it to spread receive far less attention.

analysis.methods: The methods involve analyzing the outbreak's context, including social inequities, environmental disruption, and the state of health systems in the affected regions.
analysis.main_results: The outbreak demonstrates that the conditions enabling the spread of the Bundibugyo virus are deeply rooted in social and environmental factors rather than solely biological ones.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as a call to address the underlying social and environmental determinants of the outbreak, emphasizing the need for a multifaceted public health approach.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the importance of integrating social and environmental factors into public health strategies for preventing and managing Ebola outbreaks.

analysis.summary_en: This study highlights the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as a multifaceted public health issue, not merely a virological emergency. It underscores the role of social inequities, environmental disruption, and weak health systems in facilitating the spread of the virus. The authors argue that while the virus itself is a significant concern, the conditions that allow it to thrive are equally important. The study calls for a broader public health response that addresses these underlying factors. However, the analysis is limited to an abstract-level review, which restricts the depth of evidence and leads to a moderate confidence assessment in the findings.

title: UNDERSTANDING LIPID-PROTEIN INTERACTIONS IN THE CONTEXT OF EBOLA AND MARBURG VIRUSES TO UNCOVER UNDERLYING MECHANISMS OF DISEASE PROGRESSION
abstract: Protein-lipid interactions are fundamental regulators of membrane-associated protein structure and function, thus influencing processes involving both viral life cycle and normal cellular functioning. Therefore, these interactions become important in understanding the underlying principles of progression of multitude of diseases. Viral matrix proteins are a fantastic model system to study these processes because these proteins rely heavily on host cellular membranes to coordinate trafficking and assembly. in this thesis, we have investigated the molecular mechanisms of membrane association of various proteins, with a focus on Ebola and Marburg virus matrix protein VP40.These viruses cause a highly fatal hemorrhagic fever and there is a dire need for finding ways to combat them, hence, learning how these viruses use their proteins to exploit host cellular membranes is a very important step in the battle against them. This knowledge has been further extended to the human parainfluenza virus 3 (HPIV-3) matrix protein M and the human protein ceramide kinase (CERK) to examine how they interact with certain lipids.With the help of mutagenesis, cellular assays and biochemical and biophysical approaches, this study has uncovered the essential roles of membrane binding residues of VP40 in coordinating multiple stages of viral life cycle. This has also identified critical residues in both proteins and indicated a difference in sensitivity towards mutations. We have also identified lipid binding modes of HPIV-3 M and CERK.Overall, this thesis highlights the importance of protein-lipid interactions as determinants of membrane-associated protein function and reveals how distinct molecular structure can achieve similar biological functions. These findings advance our understanding of viral assembly as well as a broader insight into lipid-dependent cellular processes.

full_text: nature microbiology https://doi.org/10.1038/s41564-026-02432-1 News & views Viral infection Ebola virus persistence and the hidden cost of immune privilege Amal Fahmi, Isabel Schultz-Pernice & Marco P. Alves Human brain organoids reveal how Ebola virus establishes persistent infection within the immune-privileged environment of the central nervous system. The idea of immune privilege has reshaped our understanding of how the immune system is regulated across tissues. It is viewed as a state of selective immune tolerance characterized by tissue- and organ-specific immune regulation. Classic examples include the central nervous sys- tem (CNS), eyes and testes, where immune surveillance is present but constrained. These sites maintain a highly regulated immunological milieu through cellular barriers, local immunoregulatory mediators and context-dependent modulation of antigen presentation. While this restrained inflammatory tone is essential to preserve the function and integrity of indispensable tissues, it comes at a cost: the same features that limit immunopathology can also reduce pathogen clearance. As a result, immune-privileged niches may be co-opted by pathogens as long-term reservoirs and enable persistence despite systemic immune surveillance. Understanding how viruses exploit these specialized envi- ronments is therefore critical for defining the mechanisms underlying chronic infection and relapse. Numerous studies have characterized viral replication dynamics, transmission and evolution during acute Ebola virus (EBOV) infection. However, increasing evidence indicates that EBOV can persist during the chronic phase, with ongoing viral replication in survivors sup- porting the concept that persistence represents an active infection Check for updates Immune-privileged CNS • Restrained inflammation • Cellular barriers (for example, BBB and choroid plexus) • Antigen drainage (glymphatics and meningeal lymphatics) • Limited immune surveillance EBOV persistence in the brain Virus exploits immune privilege to establish long-term infection The hidden cost Chronic neuroinflammation Type I IFNs and inflammatory mediators Neuron Astrocyte Microglia Oligodendrocyte Defective viral genomes Viral evolution Persistent reservoirs Neuronal dysfunction and injury Fig. 1 | Immune privilege as a double-edged sword during EBOV persistence in the CNS. The CNS maintains a tightly regulated immune environment that limits inflammation and preserves tissue integrity. In human brain organoids, EBOV infects multiple neural cell types, including neurons, astrocytes, oligodendrocytes and microglia, via viral spread through budding and direct cell-to-cell transmission. Persistent infection is associated with viral evolution and accumulation of defective viral genomes, mechanisms thought to favour chronic low-level replication. In parallel, activated microglia produce pro- inflammatory mediators and type I interferons (IFNs) that may drive chronic neuroinflammation and neuronal injury. BBB, blood–brain barrier. nature microbiology News & views within immune-privileged reservoirs1. Among these niches, the CNS has emerged as a particularly clinically relevant site, as studies in non- human primates have demonstrated that replication-competent EBOV can remain in the brain after clearance from the periphery, leading to fatal relapses2. Yet the mechanisms underlying EBOV persistence in the human CNS remain poorly understood, leaving key questions unanswered regarding the neural cell populations that support long- term infection and the associated host responses. In this issue of Nature Microbiology, Widerspick and colleagues3 provide mechanistic insights on how orthoebolaviruses exploit the CNS’s immune-privileged status to establish long-term persistence. The authors developed a human brain organoid model that enables long-term analysis of orthoebolavirus infection in the human neural tissue and tested EBOV (species Orthoebolavirus zairense), Sudan virus (species Orthoebolavirus sudanense), Reston virus (species Orthoe- bolavirus restonense), and a related filovirus, Marburg virus (species Orthomarburgvirus marburgense). In these organoids, they show that EBOV can persist for up to 120 days within diverse neural cell types, including neurons, astrocytes, microglia and oligodendrocytes. This persistence, referring to the continued presence of infectious virus or viral genetic material beyond the acute phase of infection, suggests that EBOV can establish a sustained reservoir within human neural tissue. Mechanistically, the study shows that EBOV persistence relies on both canonical viral budding and direct cell-to-cell transmission through actin-dependent cellular projections and syncytia formation. Cell-to- cell spread is recognized as a potential mechanism of immune evasion, allowing viruses to disseminate while potentially reducing exposure to soluble immune mediators4. Within highly interconnected neural tissue, this mode of spread may be advantageous, as shown by our recent work demonstrating that monkeypox virus exploits neuronal connectivity to propagate while limiting immune exposure5. Widerspick and colleagues observed that long-term persistence of EBOV was associated with ongoing viral evolution together with the accumulation of defective viral genomes. Defective viral genomes are increasingly recognized as regulators of persistent infection because they can attenuate cytopathic replication while allowing for minimal levels of viral activity. By interfering with replication of full-length viral genomes, defective viral genomes have been proposed to modulate viral replication and host responses, potentially reducing cytopathic effects and contributing to persistence6. Importantly, the study iden- tifies marked cell type-specific differences in the host response to persistent EBOV infection. Whereas infected astrocytes remained comparatively quiescent, microglia mounted robust pro-inflammatory and type I interferon responses, identifying these cells as likely drivers of the chronic neuroinflammation associated with EBOV persistence. This observation reinforces the concept that immune privilege may support long-term viral maintenance while allowing inflammatory responses to emerge once local immune activation is engaged (Fig. 1). Similar patterns have been observed in other neurotropic viral infections. Replication-competent Zika virus, for example, can persist in the brains of surviving mice for more than 1 year within inflamma- tory foci enriched in activated microglia and astrocytes, where viral persistence is associated with chronic inflammation and neuronal injury7. More broadly, persistent viral reservoirs represent one of sev- eral proposed mechanisms contributing to post-acute sequelae of infection, including long COVID, in which sustained immune activation may result from a combination of viral persistence, immune dysregula- tion and other host factors8,9. Whether the mechanisms of CNS persis- tence identified for EBOV are conserved among other Orthoebolavirus species such as Bundibugyo virus — the driving pathogen of the current Ebola disease outbreak — remains unclear. Bundibugyo virus has shown evidence of CNS involvement in animal models, with viral antigen and RNA detected in CNS-associated tissues10,11, and long-term neurological sequelae reported in human survivors12. However, whether Bundibugyo virus establishes CNS persistence through similar cellular tropism and host–virus interactions remains unknown. Comparative studies will be required to determine whether CNS persistence represents a conserved feature across all orthoebolaviruses and to define the viral and host determinants that enable long-term infection within neural tissue. Although brain organoids provide a valuable platform to investi- gate EBOV persistence in human neural tissue, they remain a simplified representation of the CNS and do not fully recapitulate the complex immune, barrier and cellular interactions that shape viral persistence within the intact CNS. Consequently, caution is warranted when extrapo- lating these findings to human disease. This is particularly relevant given that the CNS maintains selective communication with the peripheral immune system through structures such as the glymphatic system and meningeal lymphatic vessels, which facilitate antigen clearance and immune cross-talk between the brain and peripheral lymphoid organs. The meninges, choroid plexus and perivascular spaces are also recognized as neuroimmune hubs that coordinate immune surveillance, antigen presentation and leukocyte trafficking13. Addressing these ques- tions will be essential to determine whether EBOV persistence reflects escape from immune surveillance or an active adaptation to the CNS environment. Future organoid models incorporating cellular barriers, vascular components and peripheral immune cells will help determine how these virus–host interactions are shaped by neuroimmune com- munication and how EBOV establishes and maintains CNS reservoirs. They may also clarify whether microglia promote or restrict persistence and whether viral evolution within the CNS contributes to relapse or transmission. Collectively, these next-generation human brain models will provide a framework to investigate the mechanisms governing viral persistence in the CNS in a more physiologically relevant context. title_original: Ebola virus persistence and the hidden cost of immune privilege.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how Ebola virus exploits immune-privileged environments like the central nervous system to establish persistent infection, addressing the knowledge gap in viral persistence mechanisms and the role of immune privilege in chronic infections.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research used human brain organoids to model the central nervous system environment, examining Ebola virus infection dynamics across multiple neural cell types including neurons, astrocytes, oligodendrocytes and microglia.
analysis.methods: The study characterized viral replication dynamics, transmission mechanisms, viral evolution, and host immune responses in brain organoids, focusing on viral spread through budding and cell-to-cell transmission, and analysis of defective viral genomes and inflammatory mediator production.
analysis.main_results: Ebola virus infected multiple neural cell types in human brain organoids, establishing persistent infection associated with viral evolution, accumulation of defective viral genomes, and production of pro-inflammatory mediators and type I interferons by activated microglia.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that immune privilege enables Ebola virus persistence by limiting pathogen clearance while allowing chronic low-level replication, with the novel finding that this persistence leads to chronic neuroinflammation and neuronal injury through viral evolution and immune activation.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform surveillance strategies for Ebola virus persistence in the central nervous system, highlight the need for therapies targeting viral reservoirs in immune-privileged sites, and suggest potential neurological complications in survivors.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how Ebola virus establishes persistent infection in immune-privileged environments like the central nervous system using human brain organoids. The research demonstrates that Ebola virus infects multiple neural cell types (neurons, astrocytes, oligodendrocytes, and microglia) through viral budding and cell-to-cell transmission. Persistent infection is associated with viral evolution, accumulation of defective viral genomes, and production of pro-inflammatory mediators and type I interferons by activated microglia, which may drive chronic neuroinflammation and neuronal injury. The findings reveal that immune privilege, while protecting essential tissues, can be exploited by pathogens as long-term reservoirs, with significant implications for understanding chronic infections and neurological complications in Ebola survivors.

Mechanistically, the study shows that EBOV persistence relies on both canonical viral budding and direct cell-to-cell transmission through actin-dependent cellular projections and syncytia formation. More broadly, persistent viral reservoirs represent one of sev- eral proposed mechanisms contributing to post-acute sequelae of infection, including long COVID, in which sustained immune activation may result from a combination of viral persistence, immune dysregula- tion and other host factors8,9. nature microbiology https://doi.org/10.1038/s41564-026-02432-1 News & views Viral infection Ebola virus persistence and the hidden cost of immune privilege Amal Fahmi, Isabel Schultz-Pernice & Marco P. Alves Human brain organoids reveal how Ebola virus establishes persistent infection within the immune-privileged environment of the central nervous system. The idea of immune privilege has reshaped our understanding of how the immune system is regulated across tissues. It is viewed as a state of selective immune tolerance characterized by tissue- and organ-specific immune regulation. Classic examples include the central nervous sys- tem (CNS), eyes and testes, where immune surveillance is present but constrained. These sites maintain a highly regulated immunological milieu through cellular barriers, local immunoregulatory mediators and context-dependent modulation of antigen presentation.
